newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Wheat values steady, corn mixed.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Wheat values steady, corn mixed.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf nearby hard red winter wheat bids were unchanged Thursday after rising sharply Wednesday. Wheat supplies remain tight in export channels.
Sri Lanka was to tender late Thursday night for 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin hard wheat for late May-July shipment. Soft red winter wheat basis bids were unchanged.
Corn basis values were mostly unchanged in light dealings, dealers said.
Soybean values also were steady. Taiwan and South Korea were scheduled to tender late Thursday for 12,000 and 35,000 tonnes, respectively, of U.S. soybeans for June shipment.
